title: SEC-4: create credential files private from the start
head: 8fa491efedb19a4bb0da7aa97ab1363b4db74021
brief: Discord connect and Google connect created the token file with write_text at the umask mode and chmodded it afterwards; spotify_auth._store wrote a fixed <name>.tmp at umask mode, followed a symlink at that name and left the temp behind on failure. New jarvis/private_write.py write_private(path, data: bytes): unique temp name beside the target, created O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC at 0600, fsync, os.replace, temp unlinked on any failure. browser/host._write_private delegates to it and subagents._compact calls it. Acceptance tests (tests/private_writes_check.py) were committed first.
focus: file mode from the first byte
callers keep their names and signatures
